messages:
ops_lead: Postmortem INC-2027 posted. We need concrete runbook/playbook updates to stop repeats: triage steps, exact commands, escalation path, and owners with ETAs. Who picks what? Link: https://redwood.in/p/INC-2027

maria: I will own runbook edits. Will add a compact triage checklist, exact commands to capture logs + eviction metrics, and an escalation flow. ETA: Tue EOD.

ajay: I'll take autoscaler headroom analysis and a canary config for capacity. Will attach metrics and open PR by Fri.

sasha: I'll tune alerts: composite alert for eviction+latency and a weekly anomaly query so we catch recurrence without unnecessary pages.

devon: Dropped a short triage snippet in the temp doc for Maria to fold in.

# quick triage commands
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference -c runtime --since=10m | grep -i eviction
redis-cli INFO memory | grep used_memory_human
curl -s 'http://metrics/api/v1/query?query=rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])'

sam: I'll prototype a cache warmup job before scheduled bursts and link to parent ticket.

incident-bot: Follow-ups created and reminders set for owners (parent ticket INC-2027-FW).

ops_lead: Please link PRs to INC-2027-FW and update weekly until closed. Tag this thread when PRs are live. :thumbsup:
